legend: The Dancing Plague of 1518 (Strasbourg, Holy Roman Empire / now France)
lines: In July 1518, in Strasbourg, a woman stepped into the street and began to dance.
Legend says she danced for days, without joy and without rest.
Soon dozens of townspeople joined her, unable to stop.
Within weeks, old chronicles say, hundreds were dancing.
The council thought more dancing would cure it, so they hired musicians and built a stage.
So the dancers were sent to a mountain shrine to pray.
Then, as suddenly as it began, the dancing faded away.
No one knows why. Moldy bread? Stress? Mass hysteria?
What do you think made them dance?
title: The Town That Could Not Stop Dancing in 1518 #shorts
description:
In July 1518 the people of Strasbourg began to dance and, according to old chronicles, could not stop. A real historical mystery that is still unexplained.
